review: FR-02 Project Format and Migration Torture Test
completionRule: Every Critical/High finding is assigned to an existing backlog owner; v3 freeze is conditional on the listed gates.

findings.title: Connected v2 migrations retain v2-only affectsResult and produce invalid v3
findings.failureScenario: The function builds migratedConnections but writes sorted project.graph.connections. Any connected v2 target retains affectsResult, which v3 rejects.
findings.repair: Write migratedConnections, detect affectsResult/kind conflicts, validate target before receipt.

findings.title: Legacy node and catalog placeholder digests use incompatible formulas
findings.failureScenario: requiredOperators uses an array-tag placeholder while target nodes use a legacyOperatorContract object placeholder; the catalog cannot authoritatively bind the graph.
findings.repair: Never present placeholders as executable semantics. Quarantine, then atomically rebind every node to one sealed catalog and record a resolution receipt.

findings.title: v2→v3 silently changes stable-ID and PRNG semantics
findings.failureScenario: Target declares v2 ID/PRNG while source declared v1, but the migration receipt has no loss for changed generated identities or streams.
findings.repair: Emit blocking LEGACY_PRNG_AND_STABLE_ID_SEMANTICS_CHANGED; preserve source bytes; require replay/materialization/review.

findings.title: Migration may issue a receipt for an invalid target
findings.failureScenario: The target is digested without mandatory target runtime/schema validation; legacy receipts/material kinds can create dangling or illegal v3 state.
findings.repair: Validate every edge output and final target; no receipt/commit on invalid output.

findings.title: Legacy connection affectsResult conflicts are not surfaced
findings.failureScenario: v2 persisted a Boolean while v3 derives result effect from kind. Contradictory legacy values cannot be silently discarded.
findings.repair: Emit blocking LEGACY_CONNECTION_AFFECTS_RESULT_CONFLICT and preserve exact source.

findings.title: Project asset metadata and package asset members lack closure validation
findings.failureScenario: Manifest/member integrity is checked, but each project asset is not required to have exactly one measured content-addressed member with matching digest/bytes/media type.
findings.repair: Add project↔member closure plus migration source-blob closure.

findings.title: Migration receipt v2 is audit-capable but not rollback-sufficient by itself
findings.failureScenario: sourceBytesDigest is optional and no retained byte location is bound. A digest cannot reconstruct source bytes.
findings.repair: Require sourceBytesDigest for persisted migration and retain measured source bytes as a content-addressed package/repository blob.

findings.title: Compatibility negotiation omits required numerical profile
findings.failureScenario: Profile-numeric graphs can pass project compatibility without confirming numerical profile/backend support.
findings.repair: When a graph contains profile-numeric operators, require supported numerical profile identity before execution.

findings.title: Swift DTO decode is not the strict JSON trust boundary
findings.failureScenario: Foundation JSONDecoder DTO tests do not prove duplicate-key, unsafe-number, malformed-UTF8, or boundedness parity.
findings.repair: Preflight identical bytes with agl-strict-json-v1-equivalent native parser and run native-parity-cases.json.

findings.title: payloadRef has no portable addressing contract
findings.failureScenario: The field is accepted but no resolver namespace, digest binding, package member, or cross-client semantics exists.
findings.repair: Treat payloadAssetId as portable authority; quarantine payloadRef unless a required semantic extension defines its resolver.

findings.title: Lab presets are presentation hints rather than versioned semantic presets
findings.failureScenario: Lab IDs exist, but no persisted lab-preset contract binds result-affecting defaults.
findings.repair: Unknown defaultLab falls back harmlessly; result-affecting presets must compile into graph/material state or required semantic extensions.

findings.title: Migration receipt invariants are not enforced as a relationship
findings.failureScenario: Schema permits requiresUserReview=false with blocking losses and does not prove source/target bytes/digests.
findings.repair: Add runtime receipt validation: blocking iff review; applied edge chain; measured source and target digest closure.

findings.title: v2 schema and runtime disagree on optional operatorSemanticDigest
findings.failureScenario: Runtime type/validator admits operatorSemanticDigest while public v2 additionalProperties:false does not.
findings.repair: Public v2 schema wins; private dialect is refused or handled by an explicitly versioned importer, never silently.

findings.title: FR-01 source-byte migration test uses the wrong input property
findings.failureScenario: The test passes sourceBytesSha256 while implementation expects sourceBytesDigest, so source-byte carry-through is not exercised.
findings.repair: Correct the test and add FR02-P08.

findings.title: Unicode normalization is not stated as part of canonical identity
findings.failureScenario: Well-formed Unicode is enforced, but NFC/NFD are not normalized; visually equal seeds/IDs/semantic strings can hash differently.
findings.repair: Freeze the actual rule: no Unicode normalization in canonical v1; add cross-language vectors and UI warnings for seed copy/paste.

findings.title: Legacy sourceSemanticDigest is not comparable to project-v3 semantic digest
findings.failureScenario: For v1/v2 the field is canonicalDigestV1 of the full parsed project, including editorial/opaque state; v3 uses a result-affecting projection. The identical field name hides version-specific meaning.
findings.repair: Document it as the normalized source-version digest, bind its algorithm to the source schema, and never compare it across schema versions as execution equality.
